# Simplicity.IO

> Small, focused Android apps by Simplicity.IO. Contact: simplicity.io.dev@outlook.com

## Apps

- [Mainline Module Info](https://simplicity-io.github.io/mainline-module-info/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.trainspotting)): shows which Google Play system (Mainline) modules a device runs and tracks their updates. Android 10+ (API 29). Module history is stored on-device.
- [Linux Terminal Helper](https://simplicity-io.github.io/linux-terminal-helper/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.toybox)): guides you through turning on Android's built-in Linux Terminal (Debian in a virtual machine, on Google Pixel and other supported devices with Android 15 QPR2 or later) and opens it with one tap. Android 15+ (API 35). Pseudonymous usage and crash data is sent (see the [privacy policy](https://simplicity-io.github.io/linux-terminal-helper/privacy/)).
- [OnDevice AI Meter](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.benchpress)): measures how fast and how correctly a phone's CPU, graphics processor and AI processor run real AI models, offline. Tests: photo recognition, object detection, sound recognition, image style, speech to text and a 1.7B-class chat model (Qwen3 1.7B). Every processor's answers are checked against the CPU, which is checked against PC reference answers. Output: one AI Capability Score (a reference phone on battery = 6000 in total, 1000 per test), a level, and per-test results. An efficiency test (on by default, not in the score) shows how much CPU work the AI or graphics processor saves at a steady photo rate. A full run takes about 12 to 27 minutes. Android 11+ (API 30), 4 GB RAM. Free, with ads. The tests run offline; pseudonymous usage data is sent (see the privacy policy).

## Documentation

- [OnDevice AI Meter: questions and answers](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/faq/) (also in Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese): how the benchmark works, supported phones, why the CPU is the reference, what the score doesn't show, privacy, scores and result labels.
- [OnDevice AI Meter: test methodology](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/methodology/) (English): tests, models, processors, timing, answer checks, scoring, the efficiency test and known limitations.
- [OnDevice AI Meter: phone rankings](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/rankings/) (English): comparable scores for the phones measured so far, on one scale.
- [OnDevice AI Meter: what changed](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/news/) (English): changes to how phones are tested and scored, newest first.
- [OnDevice AI Meter: privacy policy](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/privacy/) (English).
